The Boys (2019) 

“The Boys” (2019) is a satirical, dark comedy series set in a world where superpowered individuals are idolized as celebrities and owned by the corrupt corporate conglomerate, Vought International. The series follows a non-powered, black-ops vigilante group determined to expose the dark, often horrific truth behind these corrupt heroes.

source_details.synopsis: The Boys is an American satirical superhero television series developed by Eric Kripke for Amazon Prime Video. Based on the comic book series of the same name by Garth Ennis and Darick Robertson, it follows the eponymous team of vigilantes as they combat superpowered individuals, referred to as "Supes", who often abuse their powers for personal gain and work for a powerful company, Vought International, that ensures the general public views them as heroes.
